dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "Hehe, the fish from here must taste amazing! Klee really wants to try one..."

dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "Alright, let's go catch some fish together! But we need to be quiet, okay? We mustn't let my big sister find out."

dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "Haha, I sure do, but I like catching them even more! When we were kids, my sister and I used to go catching fish together sometimes. She might look super-serious now, but let me tell you, when she was a kid, she was so much fun. She even had a pet tortoise! Hehe, can you imagine?"
